text_block_list.text:
Passing behind the school building by chance,
I stumbled upon Nice Nature and her friends deep in discussion.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaay!! Nature's Trainer!
Talk about a god-tier encounter! Grab the camera for a sec☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I was just recording a video message for Nature's little brother!
Could you hold the camera for me?"

A hype combo that leaves no room for refusal.
And so, here I am holding up my smartphone camera, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, what's really the best way to cheer someone on while they're practicing riding a tricycle...? I guess making a big, lively racket together..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't we just try that and it fell flat?
Having just one beloved big sister is more than enough!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, even if it's for her little brother...
To think Nature would volunteer to film a cheer video!
I thought she'd complain about it being too 'sparkly' and refuse."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, it's definitely not like me, but...
cheering someone on isn't something to sneeze at, is it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You know, when you hear your name called while running,
it really makes you feel like you can't slack off.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Part of me feels like, 'Whoa, that's a lot of pressure,'
but it's also true that it somehow gives me
the drive to do my best."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So I was thinking maybe I could ask you two high-energy folks to help film a nice cheer video...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I feel you~! Totally get it, total comprehension!!
Like, if you hype me up, I'll get hyped too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally! You just wanna give your little brother
the same kindness you were given, right, Nature?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then we've totally gotta shoot the ultimate video!
Let's hype up the festival with Nature's emotional vibes☆
Let's gooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's deliver Nature's support in the best way possible!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, so with that said!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Time to hype up Nature's super emotional, precious, max-vibes fest video! Wheeew!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Are these people... for real...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, thanks a lot... Wait, wait, hold on. Is it really okay to send a video of yourself in a cheerleading outfit to your own little brother?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We're here to cheer, so let's hype up the look!
No worries, no worries, it totally, seriously suits you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If your little brother sees you giving it your all, Big Sis,
he'll find the strength to do his best too!
Now, we just need to figure out how to cheer him on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, if it were you, Trainer,
what kind of cheering would cheer you up?
choice_data_list: Cheering like a true big sister

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's so unlike Big Sis, and
I'd never dress like this at home, but...
Well, I'll give it my best shot...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahem.
...I hear you've been working hard practicing on your tricycle.
Good girl, big sister is so proud of you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Unlike me, she's a hard worker.
I'm sure she'll learn to ride in no time, but
think of this as support from your good-for-nothing older sister.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there! Don't lose, don't be afraid.
Your big sister's right here with you...!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: G... Go with guts!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It's no good, I've completely forgotten
how I usually act.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, looking great!
It really brings out the best in you, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
This is totally gonna blow up!
Btw, can I post this on Umatok?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Nature isn't really
that kind of character, is she?!
Like, who's even gonna enjoy seeing that in the first place—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And Nature's Trainer is gonna be totally hyped by that, right?!
You got this, totally got this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Your little brother will be thrilled for sure!
You can do it, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, geez, YES!
I get it. I'll do it, alright...?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm the one who said cheering gives you strength...
R-Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
F-Fight♪ Fight♪
A tricycle is nothing... to be afraid of☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now right foot♪ Now left foot♪
Push down the pedals♪ And away you go♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I can definitely ride it♪ Fight, oh~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, looking great!
It really brings out the best in you, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
This is totally gonna blow up!
Btw, can I post this on Umatok?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: An absolute no-go.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I got a lot of tips and finished the video, but sending it is so cringe...
My little brother's totally gonna laugh at me when he's older...
choice_data_list: Then how about I walk you back?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm definitely going to send it.
Sure, it might end up being certified cringe history, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—I mean, we've got the cheers of all four of us behind it, right?
I'm pretty sure it'll be super effective!

Nice Nature gazed at the video looking
a tiny bit proud of herself.
It seems to have been a great learning experience...!
